title: Reported speech advanced
note: reporting verbs beyond say/tell · verb (+ object) + to-infinitive · verb + -ing and verb + preposition + -ing · verb + (that) clause, incl. suggest/insist + should or base form · choosing the verb that fits the pattern · 4 strands x 12 · 48 items · built to live 2026-08-06 (cloud run 7)

blocks.title: Reported speech advanced · reporting verbs · B2

items.en: She refused to sign the contract.
items.gap: She refused ____ sign the contract.
accepts: She refused to sign the contract.
items.explanation: refuse + to + infinitive. No object goes between them.
items.explanation_cz: refuse + to + infinitiv. Mezi ně nepatří žádný předmět.

items.en: He promised to call me in the evening.
items.gap: He promised ____ call me in the evening.
accepts: He promised to call me in the evening.
items.explanation: promise + to + infinitive. Czech uses a že-clause here, English an infinitive.
items.explanation_cz: promise + to + infinitiv. Čeština tu má vedlejší větu se "že", angličtina infinitiv.

items.en: They offered to help with the project.
items.gap: They offered ____ help with the project.
accepts: They offered to help with the project.
items.explanation: offer + to + infinitive.
items.explanation_cz: offer + to + infinitiv.

items.en: We agreed to meet in the hotel.
items.cz: Domluvili jsme se, že se sejdeme v hotelu.
items.gap: We agreed ____ meet in the hotel.
accepts: We agreed to meet in the hotel.
items.explanation: agree + to + infinitive when you agree to DO something.
items.explanation_cz: agree + to + infinitiv, když souhlasíte, že něco uděláte.

items.en: She reminded me to check the deadline.
items.gap: She reminded ____ to check the deadline.
accepts: She reminded me to check the deadline.
items.explanation: remind + somebody + to. The person comes straight after the verb, with no to.
items.explanation_cz: remind + někdo + to. Osoba stojí hned za slovesem, bez to.

items.en: He invited us to visit the office.
items.gap: He invited us ____ visit the office.
accepts: He invited us to visit the office.
items.explanation: invite + somebody + to + infinitive.
items.explanation_cz: invite + někdo + to + infinitiv.

items.en: My manager encouraged me to study more.
items.cz: Můj manažer mě povzbudil, abych se víc učil.
items.gap: My manager encouraged ____ to study more.
accepts: My manager encouraged me to study more.
items.explanation: encourage + somebody + to + infinitive.
items.explanation_cz: encourage + někdo + to + infinitiv.

items.en: She persuaded her sister to stay one more day.
items.cz: Přemluvila svou sestru, aby zůstala ještě jeden den.
items.gap: She persuaded her sister ____ stay one more day.
accepts: She persuaded her sister to stay one more day.
items.explanation: persuade + somebody + to + infinitive.
items.explanation_cz: persuade + někdo + to + infinitiv.

items.en: The doctor told him to rest.
items.gap: The doctor told him ____ rest.
accepts: The doctor told him to rest.
items.explanation: tell + somebody + to + infinitive. tell always needs the person.
items.explanation_cz: tell + někdo + to + infinitiv. Po tell musí vždy stát osoba.

items.en: He warned us not to open the door.
items.cz: Varoval nás, abychom neotevírali ty dveře.
items.gap: He warned us ____ to open the door.
accepts: He warned us not to open the door.
items.explanation: The negative goes in front of to: not to open.
items.explanation_cz: Zápor stojí před to: not to open.

items.en: They asked me to send the report.
items.cz: Požádali mě, abych poslal tu zprávu.
items.gap: They asked me ____ send the report.
accepts: They asked me to send the report.
items.explanation: ask + somebody + to + infinitive = a request.
items.explanation_cz: ask + někdo + to + infinitiv = žádost.

items.en: She promised not to be late again.
items.gap: She promised ____ to be late again.
accepts: She promised not to be late again.
items.explanation: not to + infinitive, even when Czech negates the verb itself.
items.explanation_cz: not to + infinitiv, i když čeština zaporuje samo sloveso.

items.en: He denied taking the money.
items.gap: He denied ____ the money.
accepts: He denied taking the money.
items.explanation: deny + -ing. Never deny to do.
items.explanation_cz: deny + -ing. Nikdy ne deny to do.

items.en: She suggested moving the meeting to Friday.
items.cz: Navrhla přesunout tu schůzku na pátek.
items.gap: She suggested ____ the meeting to Friday.
accepts: She suggested moving the meeting to Friday.
items.explanation: suggest + -ing. suggest to do does not exist in English.
items.explanation_cz: suggest + -ing. Vazba suggest to do v angličtině neexistuje.

items.en: They admitted making a mistake.
items.gap: They admitted ____ a mistake.
accepts: They admitted making a mistake.
items.explanation: admit + -ing (or admit that + clause).
items.explanation_cz: admit + -ing (nebo admit that + věta).

items.en: He recommended booking the hotel early.
items.gap: He recommended ____ the hotel early.
accepts: He recommended booking the hotel early.
items.explanation: recommend + -ing, like suggest.
items.explanation_cz: recommend + -ing, stejně jako suggest.

items.en: She apologised for being late.
items.cz: Omluvila se za to, že přišla pozdě.
items.gap: She apologised ____ being late.
accepts: She apologised for being late.
She apologized for being late.
items.explanation: apologise for + -ing. No object: you apologise TO somebody FOR something.
items.explanation_cz: apologise for + -ing. Bez předmětu: omlouváte se TO někomu FOR za něco.

items.en: He insisted on paying for dinner.
items.cz: Trval na tom, že večeři zaplatí.
items.gap: He insisted ____ paying for dinner.
accepts: He insisted on paying for dinner.
items.explanation: insist on + -ing.
items.explanation_cz: insist on + -ing.

items.en: They thanked us for helping.
items.gap: They thanked us ____ helping.
accepts: They thanked us for helping.
items.explanation: thank + somebody + for + -ing. The person comes before the preposition.
items.explanation_cz: thank + někdo + for + -ing. Osoba stojí před předložkou.

items.en: She accused him of breaking the laptop.
items.cz: Obvinila ho, že rozbil ten notebook.
items.gap: She accused him ____ breaking the laptop.
accepts: She accused him of breaking the laptop.
items.explanation: accuse + somebody + of + -ing.
items.explanation_cz: accuse + někdo + of + -ing.

items.en: He congratulated me on passing the exam.
items.gap: He congratulated me ____ passing the exam.
accepts: He congratulated me on passing the exam.
items.explanation: congratulate + somebody + on + -ing.
items.explanation_cz: congratulate + někdo + on + -ing.

items.en: They blamed us for the noise.
items.gap: They blamed us ____ the noise.
accepts: They blamed us for the noise.
items.explanation: blame + somebody + for + something.
items.explanation_cz: blame + někdo + for + něco.

items.en: He mentioned meeting the client last week.
items.cz: Zmínil, že se minulý týden setkal s klientem.
items.gap: He mentioned ____ the client last week.
accepts: He mentioned meeting the client last week.
items.explanation: mention + -ing when you report an action.
items.explanation_cz: mention + -ing, když převyprávíte nějakou činnost.

items.en: She avoided speaking to the manager.
items.cz: Vyhýbala se tomu, aby s manažerem mluvila.
items.gap: She avoided ____ to the manager.
accepts: She avoided speaking to the manager.
items.explanation: avoid + -ing.
items.explanation_cz: avoid + -ing.

items.en: He admitted that he was wrong.
items.gap: He admitted ____ he was wrong.
accepts: He admitted that he was wrong.
He admitted he was wrong.
items.explanation: admit that + clause. that can be left out in speech.
items.explanation_cz: admit that + věta. V mluvené řeči lze that vynechat.

items.en: She explained that the office was closed.
items.gap: She explained ____ the office was closed.
accepts: She explained that the office was closed.
She explained the office was closed.
items.explanation: explain that + clause. If you name the person: explain TO somebody.
items.explanation_cz: explain that + věta. Když uvedete osobu: explain TO někomu.

items.en: They complained that the room was too small.
items.cz: Stěžovali si, že pokoj je příliš malý.
items.gap: They complained ____ the room was too small.
accepts: They complained that the room was too small.
items.explanation: complain that + clause (or complain about + noun).
items.explanation_cz: complain that + věta (nebo complain about + podstatné jméno).

items.en: He claimed that he had paid the bill.
items.gap: He claimed that he ____ paid the bill.
accepts: He claimed that he had paid the bill.
items.explanation: The reported clause backshifts: paid becomes had paid.
items.explanation_cz: Ve vedlejší větě se čas posouvá: paid se mění na had paid.

items.en: She mentioned that the price had changed.
items.gap: She mentioned that the price ____ changed.
accepts: She mentioned that the price had changed.
items.explanation: mention that + clause, with the usual backshift.
items.explanation_cz: mention that + věta, s obvyklým posunem času.

items.en: The manager announced that the project was finished.
items.cz: Manažer oznámil, že projekt je hotový.
items.gap: The manager announced ____ the project was finished.
accepts: The manager announced that the project was finished.
items.explanation: announce that + clause. No person goes after announce.
items.explanation_cz: announce that + věta. Za announce nepatří osoba.

items.en: He pointed out that the contract was not signed.
items.cz: Upozornil na to, že smlouva není podepsaná.
items.gap: He pointed ____ that the contract was not signed.
accepts: He pointed out that the contract was not signed.
items.explanation: point out that + clause.
items.explanation_cz: point out that + věta.

items.en: She insisted that we take a taxi.
items.cz: Trvala na tom, abychom si vzali taxi.
items.gap: She insisted that we ____ a taxi.
accepts: She insisted that we take a taxi.
She insisted that we should take a taxi.
items.explanation: After insist that, English uses the base form — take, not takes or took.
items.explanation_cz: Po insist that se používá základní tvar — take, ne takes ani took.

items.en: He suggested that we should wait.
items.gap: He suggested that we ____ wait.
accepts: He suggested that we should wait.
He suggested that we wait.
items.explanation: suggest that + should + base form is the safe written version.
items.explanation_cz: suggest that + should + základní tvar je bezpečná psaná varianta.

items.en: She said that she would call later.
items.gap: She said that she ____ call later.
accepts: She said that she would call later.
items.explanation: will backshifts to would inside the reported clause.
items.explanation_cz: will se ve vedlejší větě posouvá na would.

items.en: He told me that he was busy.
items.gap: He told ____ that he was busy.
accepts: He told me that he was busy.
items.explanation: tell needs a person; say does not take one directly.
items.explanation_cz: tell potřebuje osobu; say ji přímo nepřipouští.

items.en: They agreed that the price was too high.
items.cz: Shodli se, že cena je příliš vysoká.
items.gap: They agreed ____ the price was too high.
accepts: They agreed that the price was too high.
items.explanation: agree that + clause when you agree with an opinion.
items.explanation_cz: agree that + věta, když souhlasíte s názorem.

items.en: He accused me of taking his phone.
items.cz: Obvinil mě, že jsem mu vzal telefon.
items.gap: He ____ me of taking his phone.
accepts: He accused me of taking his phone.
items.explanation: of + -ing after the person points to accuse.
items.explanation_cz: Vazba of + -ing za osobou ukazuje na accuse.

items.en: The doctor advised me to rest for a week.
items.cz: Doktor mi doporučil, abych týden odpočíval.
items.gap: The doctor ____ me to rest for a week.
accepts: The doctor advised me to rest for a week.
items.explanation: advise + somebody + to. suggest cannot take a person like this.
items.explanation_cz: advise + někdo + to. suggest takto osobu nepřipouští.

items.en: She insisted on seeing the manager.
items.cz: Trvala na tom, že chce mluvit s manažerem.
items.gap: She ____ on seeing the manager.
accepts: She insisted on seeing the manager.
items.explanation: Only insist takes on + -ing here.
items.explanation_cz: Vazbu on + -ing tu bere jen insist.

items.en: They blamed us for the broken window.
items.gap: They ____ us for the broken window.
accepts: They blamed us for the broken window.
items.explanation: blame somebody FOR; accuse somebody OF.
items.explanation_cz: blame někoho FOR; accuse někoho OF.

items.en: He congratulated us on the result.
items.gap: He ____ us on the result.
accepts: He congratulated us on the result.
items.explanation: congratulate somebody ON; thank somebody FOR.
items.explanation_cz: congratulate někoho ON; thank někoho FOR.

items.en: She apologised for arriving late.
items.gap: She ____ for arriving late.
accepts: She apologised for arriving late.
She apologized for arriving late.
items.explanation: apologise for + -ing, with no object after the verb.
items.explanation_cz: apologise for + -ing, bez předmětu za slovesem.

items.en: He denied breaking the window.
items.gap: He ____ breaking the window.
accepts: He denied breaking the window.
items.explanation: deny takes -ing straight after it; refuse would need to + infinitive.
items.explanation_cz: deny bere -ing hned za sebou; refuse by potřebovalo to + infinitiv.

items.en: She warned me not to touch it.
items.cz: Varovala mě, abych se toho nedotýkal.
items.gap: She ____ me not to touch it.
accepts: She warned me not to touch it.
items.explanation: warn + somebody + not to + infinitive.
items.explanation_cz: warn + někdo + not to + infinitiv.

items.en: He suggested that we should leave early.
items.gap: He ____ that we should leave early.
accepts: He suggested that we should leave early.
items.explanation: suggest that + should. advise would need a person before to.
items.explanation_cz: suggest that + should. advise by potřebovalo osobu před to.

items.en: The manager announced that the office would close at six.
items.cz: Manažer oznámil, že kancelář zavře v šest.
items.gap: The manager ____ that the office would close at six.
accepts: The manager announced that the office would close at six.
items.explanation: announce that + clause, with no person after the verb.
items.explanation_cz: announce that + věta, bez osoby za slovesem.

items.en: She reminded me to send the report.
items.cz: Připomněla mi, abych poslal tu zprávu.
items.gap: She ____ me to send the report.
accepts: She reminded me to send the report.
items.explanation: remind + somebody + to + infinitive.
items.explanation_cz: remind + někdo + to + infinitiv.

items.en: He refused to pay for the tickets.
items.gap: He ____ to pay for the tickets.
accepts: He refused to pay for the tickets.
items.explanation: refuse + to + infinitive; deny would need -ing.
items.explanation_cz: refuse + to + infinitiv; deny by potřebovalo -ing.

cards.title: The reporting verb carries the message
cards.body: At B1 you reported with **said** and **told** and moved the tense back. At B2 you choose a verb that already says what the speaker was **doing** — refusing, suggesting, admitting, apologising. The price is that each verb comes with its own pattern, and the pattern is not the one Czech would predict.
cards.body_cz: Na úrovni B1 jste převyprávěli pomocí **said** a **told** a posunuli čas. Na B2 volíte sloveso, které samo říká, co mluvčí **dělal** — odmítal, navrhoval, přiznával, omlouval se. Daní za to je, že každé sloveso má svou vlastní vazbu, a ta se neřídí češtinou.

table.caption: Four patterns — the verb decides which one
rows: She refused to sign the contract.
They asked me to send the report.
He admitted that he was wrong.

cards.title: Where the person goes
cards.body: Some verbs need a person straight after them with **no to**: *tell / ask / remind / warn / invite / encourage / persuade / advise* + somebody + to. Others take no person at all: *refuse / promise / offer / agree / suggest / announce*. Getting this wrong is the single most common B2 error in this area.
cards.body_cz: Některá slovesa potřebují hned za sebou osobu, a to **bez to**: *tell / ask / remind / warn / invite / encourage / persuade / advise* + někdo + to. Jiná osobu nepřipouštějí vůbec: *refuse / promise / offer / agree / suggest / announce*. Chyba právě tady je na úrovni B2 nejčastější.
points: She reminded me to check the deadline. (person, no to before it)
He promised to call me in the evening. (no person after promise)
Not: He suggested me to wait. → He suggested that I should wait.
The negative sits in front of to: He warned us not to open the door.

cards.title: Preposition + -ing: the person comes first
cards.body: Four common verbs put the person **before** the preposition, and then only an **-ing** form can follow. The preposition is fixed and has to be learned with the verb — Czech gives you no help here.
cards.body_cz: Čtyři běžná slovesa staví osobu **před** předložku a po ní může následovat jen tvar s **-ing**. Předložka je pevně daná a je třeba se ji naučit spolu se slovesem — čeština tu nepomůže.

table.caption: Learn the preposition with the verb
rows: She accused him of breaking the laptop.
They blamed us for the noise.
He congratulated me on passing the exam.
He insisted on paying for dinner.

cards.title: suggest and insist: the base form
cards.body: **suggest** and **insist** never take *somebody to do*. They take **-ing**, or a **that**-clause in which the verb stays in its **base form** — no -s, no past — however the sentence around it is tensed. Adding **should** is the safer written option and means the same thing.
cards.body_cz: **suggest** a **insist** nikdy neberou vazbu *somebody to do*. Berou **-ing**, nebo vedlejší větu s **that**, v níž sloveso zůstává v **základním tvaru** — bez -s, bez minulého času — bez ohledu na čas věty okolo. Přidat **should** je v psaném projevu jistější a znamená totéž.
points: She insisted that we take a taxi. (not: that we took)
He suggested that we should wait. = He suggested that we wait.
She suggested moving the meeting to Friday. (-ing)
The same base form works after recommend and demand.
